chapters.title: Empty box
chapters.description: Sensors confirm the closed door and locked bolt.

chapters.title: Courier access
chapters.description: Code 2468 retracts the bolt, then opens the door.

chapters.title: Parcel placement
chapters.description: The script places the parcel. Delivery stays pending until the box locks.

chapters.title: Closing and locking
chapters.description: Door and bolt feedback confirm delivery.

chapters.title: Used courier code
chapters.description: A second request with code 2468 is denied.

chapters.title: Owner access
chapters.description: Code 1357 opens the box for collection.

chapters.title: Parcel removal
chapters.description: The script removes the parcel. The sensor change records retrieval.

chapters.title: Empty box after collection
chapters.description: The door closes and the bolt locks. Both codes have now been used.
